Selected source-patch/labelled custody checks now pass; native implementation/transaction acceptance remains separate.
selected_project_cargo_repair.before_pickup: No medical cargo aboard at acceptance. Save positive usable-hold capability and intended whole-hold obligation, not a fake cargo manifest or extra berth. Existing personal/other mission cargo is preserved and may be sold/unloaded only by explicit authorized ordinary services. Quote warns it must be cleared before medical loading; deadline continues. Hull changes before actual pickup use new real fitted capacity; do not precreate or multiply payload.
selected_project_cargo_repair.pickup_quantity_formula: At actual saved pickup-main-station loading receipt, H is current actually usable whole-tonne hold after fitted equipment/cabins and genuine capacity deductions, before normal cargo. Require H>=1 and zero other occupied hold tonnes, including large kg/g overflow pods and sealed living/quest cargo; protected kg/g safe contents with zero hold footprint remain. Missing fit blocks loading with precise reasons and preserves all cargo/people/state; never dump, force sell, store mission items or award capacity. Q=H medical tonnes is finite and fixed at this unique loading receipt.

selected_project_cargo_repair.while_aboard: Medical cargo consumes real Q tonnes, zero equipment units or passenger berths; no medical passenger grant. Preserve source whole-hold lock: other tonne cargo/scoop collection unavailable while carrying active supplies, including any extra space in a larger hull. Additional empty hold is unavailable capacity, not newly created medical mass. Safe non-hold goods remain owned and obey real capacity.
selected_project_cargo_repair.hull_and_fitting_changes: Transfer exact original consignment/quantity/condition; proposed usable hold must fit Q plus all other real constraints, else block atomic swap/installation. Larger hull creates no extra supplies or restored stock; its extra hold remains unavailable while active medical whole-hold lock applies. Personal compatible equipment transfers; surplus unique personal equipment persists in storage. Cargo/people cannot use equipment storage.
selected_project_cargo_repair.delivery_failure: Only exact bound hospital/authorized service can consume original medical consignment once. Failure removes no unrelated cargo, safe goods, people, fitted gear or stored gear. No reward revival or duplicate replacement. Genuine destroyed/irrecoverable consignment releases only its actual reservation; last phase/custody still tracked. Physical fragmentation must conserve loaded quantity across stable part/owner/destruction receipts; retain only actual remaining quantity, never restore original Q after loss.
